name: Hiiragi Ayako
source: Takahiro's older cousin that owns a cafe named Tart Time where Mio works part time. Takahiro also lives with her at Tart Time. She used to be a knight in the past, but she is now the school nurse at Wynn Ford Academy. In her route, she encourages Takahiro to become a knight again.
